subject: [PATCH 5/5] mm/huge_memory: turn the swapcache-with-mapping error case into an assert

2026-08-26.patch_summary: This patch modifies the huge_memory code to assert when a folio in the swapcache has a mapping, which is an impossible state. The original code would return -EINVAL and leave the folio frozen, but this change makes it clear that such a situation cannot occur. The assertion is made using VM_WARN_ON_ONCE_FOLIO() upfront, ensuring that the code does not attempt to recover from an invalid state.
